title: Soundness of unary decoding
statement: If a bit string is successfully read as the unary value $n$ with remaining suffix $r$, then it consists of exactly $n$ ones, followed by a zero and then $r$.
hypotheses_covered: The unary reader returns the value n and suffix r on the input bit string
replaced:
If the unary numeral reader succeeds on a bit string $x$, returning the value
$n$ and the suffix $r$, then $x$ is exactly $n$ ones, followed by a zero,
followed by $r$.
